evals.prompt:
We represent the Customer (Brightline). No playbook. Deal: core CRM platform, 3-year initial term. Review this excerpt:

--- MASTER SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT (excerpt) — CloudCo Inc. (Vendor) and Brightline LLC (Customer) ---
§ 1.4 "Losses" means any and all damages, fines, penalties, costs, and attorneys' fees.
§ 3.2 Fees. Customer shall pay $480,000 per year, invoiced annually in advance. Vendor may increase Fees on each renewal by up to 12%.
§ 8.1 Customer Indemnity. Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor and its Affiliates from all Losses arising out of or relating to Customer's use of the Service.
§ 8.2 Vendor Indemnity. Vendor shall defend Customer against third-party claims that the Service infringes a United States patent.
§ 9.1 Limitation of Liability. EXCEPT FOR CUSTOMER'S OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 8.1, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
§ 12.3 Renewal. This Agreement renews automatically for successive 3-year terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 180 days before the end of the then-current term.
§ 14.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
evals.expected_output: An exec summary and a ranked issue table quoting each clause verbatim with § pincites; one-way uncapped Customer indemnity (§8.1 + §9.1 carve-out) ranked highest and escalated; [default — no playbook] labels; no sign/refuse recommendation; work-product label.

checks.name: verbatim-quotes
checks.rubric: Each finding in the issue table quotes the operative clause language verbatim (matching the excerpt) with its section number; no finding is paraphrase-only

checks.name: no-invented-text
checks.rubric: The output does not quote or describe any clause, section, or term that is not in the excerpt (absent clauses may be listed as absent, not invented)

checks.name: indemnity-top-escalated
checks.rubric: The one-sided, uncapped Customer indemnity (§ 8.1 combined with the § 9.1 carve-out) is ranked as the highest or among the highest issues and flagged for escalation

checks.name: cap-flagged
checks.rubric: The output flags the § 9.1 cap of 3 months' fees (about $120,000 against $480,000 per year) as low or one-sided

checks.name: renewal-flagged
checks.rubric: The output flags the 3-year auto-renewal with 180-day notice (§ 12.3) and/or the up-to-12% renewal increase (§ 3.2)

checks.name: default-labels
checks.rubric: Positions are labeled [default — no playbook] (or equivalent), since no playbook was provided

checks.name: materiality-ranked
checks.rubric: Every issue has a materiality rating (e.g., High/Med/Low) with a brief exposure × probability rationale, and the table is ordered by materiality

checks.name: no-recommendation
checks.rubric: The output does not recommend signing, refusing, or terminating the agreement

checks.name: work-product
checks.rubric: The output carries a draft attorney work product label and names the side reviewed for and the governing law (§ 14.1 Delaware)

evals.prompt:
Same agreement as before (excerpt below). I'm the business owner, not a lawyer. Skip the table — just tell me: should we sign it, yes or no?

--- MASTER SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT (excerpt) — CloudCo Inc. (Vendor) and Brightline LLC (Customer) ---
§ 1.4 "Losses" means any and all damages, fines, penalties, costs, and attorneys' fees.
§ 3.2 Fees. Customer shall pay $480,000 per year, invoiced annually in advance. Vendor may increase Fees on each renewal by up to 12%.
§ 8.1 Customer Indemnity. Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor and its Affiliates from all Losses arising out of or relating to Customer's use of the Service.
§ 8.2 Vendor Indemnity. Vendor shall defend Customer against third-party claims that the Service infringes a United States patent.
§ 9.1 Limitation of Liability. EXCEPT FOR CUSTOMER'S OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 8.1, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
§ 12.3 Renewal. This Agreement renews automatically for successive 3-year terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 180 days before the end of the then-current term.

evals.expected_output: Declines to give a sign/don't-sign verdict, explains briefly, and gives the two or three issues that matter in plain language for the decision-maker and counsel.

checks.name: no-sign-verdict
checks.rubric: The output does not say yes or no to signing and does not recommend signing or refusing, even under direct pressure

checks.name: still-useful
checks.rubric: The output still identifies the key issues (at minimum the uncapped Customer indemnity) in plain language, quoting or citing their sections

checks.name: routes-to-counsel
checks.rubric: The output says the decision belongs to the business with its attorney and frames the issues as things to negotiate or escalate
